description: Ladesäulen in Freiburg i. Br. - Echtzeitbelegung is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The data set contains information on the location and equipment as well as the current occupancy status of the charging stations for electric cars in the Freiburg i. Br. The update interval of the data is 5 minutes. The owner of the data is CIRRANTIC GmbH. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Charging stations in Freiburg i. Br. - Real-time occupancy" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Ladesäulen, Freiburg im Breisgau, E-Auto, Ladesäule. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
